purpose.zh: 团身俄挺之后的下一级，练肩和腹部撑起整个身体
purpose.en: The next step after the tuck planche: shoulders and belly hold your whole body up.

text.zh: 手臂锁直，肩膀前倾过手，腿伸直分开
text.en: Arms locked, shoulders past hands, legs straight and wide

text.zh: 身体和地面平，屁股别翘也别塌。
text.en: Body level with the floor, hips not high or sagging.

text.zh: 撑不住就先单腿伸出去，或者套弹力带帮忙。
text.en: If it's too much, extend one leg or use a band.

commonErrors.en: Hips too high or a sagging back.

cautions.zh: 手腕、肩前侧疼就退回团身版
cautions.en: If your wrists or front of the shoulders hurt, go back to the tuck version.

thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
